speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis (suspected early-onset) with concurrent Respiratory Distress Syndrome.

The combination of respiratory distress immediately after birth, lack of maternal infection history, and the need for extensive microbiological workup strongly suggests a bacterial infection originating from the mother during delivery. The chest X-ray will be critical to rule out pneumonia or pneumothorax, but the clinical picture aligns most closely with sepsis. We will proceed with immediate broad-spectrum antibiotics pending culture results.
